title: One-shot out-of-sample test of the daily trend strategy
why: Every trend number so far comes from exploration data (2018-06..2024-09-28). The period after it has never been used by any trend test. Before real capital, the live strategy must be confirmed on data that played no part in choosing it.

window.note: end = start of live forward tracking, so no day is counted twice

strategy.rule: explore.VARIANTS T_don20_long: close above the prior 20-day high, entry at the next daily open, initial stop 3xATR20, trailing stop 3xATR20 on closes, max hold 120 days, long only
strategy.universe: point-in-time monthly top-50 by trailing 30-day dollar volume, same exclusions as exploration (stablecoins, pegged, wrapped, OKX-sourced)
strategy.entries_counted: trades with entry on or after start and signal before end; trades still open at end are marked to the last close for the account view but excluded from per-trade expectancy

primary_test.statistic: mean net R per trade (spot costs), top-50
primary_test.PASS: mean > 0 AND block-bootstrap (30-day blocks) one-sided 90% lower bound > 0
primary_test.CONSISTENT: mean > 0 but the 90% lower bound <= 0 (edge not confirmed, not refuted)

reported_not_decisive: account simulation exactly as the demo: 0.5% risk per trade, open-risk cap 4% (max 8 positions), entries in time order, ties by symbol
BTC buy-and-hold over the same window
drawdown distribution by risk level (block bootstrap of monthly account returns, dev + OOS)

consequences.FAIL: the panel states that the strategy failed out of sample; no real-money use recommended
consequences.CONSISTENT: the panel shows both results; real money only at minimal risk, forward record decides
consequences.PASS: the panel's evidence line switches to out-of-sample numbers

no_changes_after_seeing_results: rule, universe, costs, window and criteria above are fixed; nothing is re-run with other parameters
